mode: Offline video and sender-log analysis; no hardware or TouchDesigner changes
sequential_runner: Initial all-window process was stopped after its complete measure_15 NPZ and JSON checkpoint, because agents were independently completing the remaining windows. No partial subsequent window is used.
model_selection: Ridge model selected using separate one-hot holdouts (all on >= 0.9335, all off <= 0.0436), rather than expected dynamic frame IDs. Earlier diagonal-model evidence retained separately.
numeric_archive: Scores saved as float32 for diagnostics. Integer decisions in stats are the authoritative outputs of float64 decoding; do not silently reclassify boundary values from rounded scores.
timebase: 8x in slow windows based on independent black-phase boundaries; 1x end analyzed separately and checked against independently decoded ID progression.
progress_display: The first extractor version prints bounded_rate=null because its progress lookup uses an incorrect summary key. Archived JSON uses the correct observed_unique_fps_estimate field. Rates are read from archived JSON and independently recomputed in comparison.json.
